claims.statement: Golden Template is Learn → Practice → Assess, with distinct feedback timing and evidence semantics.
CĐ07 lesson no longer contains a duplicate static mini quiz; sections 8 and 9 are gateways.
Practice Room retains the 120-question adaptive Practice Engine and adds collapsible written solutions.
CĐ07 Readiness Check contains 10 KNTT-Core MCQs and excludes the integer-value Extension item from Core scoring.
Assessment evidence is stored separately in toan-thcs-assessment-v1; it is not mechanically merged with practice accuracy.
READY is a soft readiness state, not Mastered and not a hard gate to CĐ08.

proposed_changes.change: Freeze only after deployed desktop+iPad/mobile QA.
proposed_changes.rationale: Avoid scaling a UX defect to all topics.

proposed_changes.change: After freeze, apply template to CĐ04–CĐ06 as one batch.

tests.expected: 10 Core items; unique IDs; 4 options; valid answers; skill labels present.
Lesson contains gateways and no duplicate static mini quiz.
Practice Room contains hidden solutions and separate Extension area.
Self-test page exposes no static answer key before submit.
Deployed desktop/iPad/mobile UX works without blocking defects.

uncertainties: Container could not resolve github.com, so local MkDocs build was not run in this environment; deployed/browser QA remains the final freeze gate.

acceptance.notes: Architecture and structural QA pass. Golden Template is QA-ready, not frozen until real-device/deployed verification.
